description: Ministry of Education, Religious Affairs and Sports of Greece publishes two Ministry of Education datasets: a list of schools by regional unit, municipality and community, and the number of students per school by gender, each as a CSV export and a zipped copy. Coverage: Greece nationally; both portal records were last modified on 2026-02-22. Format and access: CSV and ZIP files, free and without registration from data.gov.gr; the portal catalogue is queryable through a public CKAN API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC BY 4.0 on every resource of the datasets (the dataset-level licence field is empty); cost: free. Caveats: the record descriptions are one line each, so the fields (coordinates, school type, year of the counts) are unconfirmed and the files were not opened; whether the list carries coordinates is unknown, and the CKAN API licence field is empty although the page shows the Open Government Licence - Toronto. Simulation uses: school locations and enrolment as critical-facility and shelter demand inputs to evacuation and flood models, and catchment or school-network capacity analysis. Related catalogue records: ELSTAT Greece 2021 Buildings Census tables down to settlement level (floors, use, construction period, frame material, roof, lifts, accessibility) (data-elstat-greece-2021-buildings-census-tables-by-settlement); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
